Gunrhein is a shooting game in which you pilot an invincible fighter craft to defend your base units from waves of enemies.
While your fighter is invincible, your base units are destroyed upon contact with an enemy. If all base units are destroyed, the game is over.
Your fighter can't attack enemies. Instead, it can set cannons. The cannons fire beams automatically to shoot down enemies.

Once set, a cannon fires until it runs out of energy. It can't rotate⑬it is set in place based on the fighter's position and direction at the time of placement. Place them well to meet oncoming enemies effectively.
A cannon does not use energy while its beam is hitting enemies. Its energy drains if its beam is firing at nothing. If the energy dwindles to nothing, the cannon flashes red before disappearing.
If the beams of multiple cannons are overlaid, they combine as a more powerful beam. If the button is held down before the cannon is placed, its beam is also intensified.
Complete five stages to clear the game.

(Gunrhein. Looks like some kind of shooter, and 100 yen to play. Do I want to give it a go?)
While your fighter is invincible, your base units are destroyed upon contact with an enemy. If you lose all of your base units, you lose.
Your fighter can't attack enemies. Instead, it places cannons. These cannons fire beam weapons automatically to shoot down enemies.

Once set, a cannon fires until it runs out of energy. It can't rotate⑬it is set in place based on the fighter's position and direction at the time of placement. Determine the best strategy to effectively shoot down enemy units!
A cannon's energy only drains if its beam is not hitting enemies. If a cannon loses all of its energy, it will flash red, then disappear.
When the beams of two or more cannons cross, they combine into a more powerful beam. You can intensify beam weapons by holding down the button before placing a cannon.
Complete five stages to beat the game.
